title: Rebaseline lightweight Observability MVP: micro-cards, trace sampling, and cost buckets
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: The original Console observability PRD included a broad set of dashboard cards, full-span tracing, and per-token/per-route cost breakdowns. Engineering and Design flagged implementation and performance risks that would push launch by 6+ weeks and increase infra cost. This ticket captures a scoped rebaseline (micro-cards + sampled traces + coarse cost buckets) and documents the acceptance criteria, trade-offs, and rollout plan.

Goals: Deliver an actionably useful first release of Console observability that surfaces latency hotspots and cost signals for most customers while minimizing engineering lift and runtime overhead. Avoid shipping features that require heavy backend aggregation, large storage retention, or complex tracing instrumentation in v1.

Non-goals for MVP: No full-span flamegraphs, no per-token line-item cost for every request, no long-term trace retention (>7 days), and no customer-level billing export in v1.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard: Three micro-cards available per project page: Query Volume (p50/p95), Average Latency (p50/p95), Error Rate — all with 1-minute granularity and a 24h default window
Dashboards: Ability to filter micro-cards by model and route (single-select); applying filter updates all three cards within 1s on the console frontend
Tracing: Lightweight sampled traces (1% sample by default) displayed in a compact waterfall view showing request timeline and top 3 span tags; clicking a sampled trace links to raw logs if present

Cost: Coarse cost buckets shown as a single stacked bar: Model Compute, Token Cost (hosted unit), and Inference Fixed — bucketed daily with 24h latency to compute; per-route roll-up available (not per-request token breakdown)
Performance: Console API endpoints used by the UI should add <50ms median p99 client latency overhead under normal load; backend aggregation jobs must complete within 60s on query
Instrumentation: No SDK changes required from customers for initial tracing — use server-side auto-instrumentation where possible
Rollout: Feature flag gated; default OFF for orgs with >500 TPS to avoid accidental load; can be enabled for beta orgs
Telemetry: Emit product usage events (card viewed, trace opened, cost filter applied) for future iteration and calibration
decisions: Cut: Remove per-token/per-step interactive cost explorer from MVP due to high compute and storage requirements
Cut: Delay full-span flamegraph and long-retention tracing to a later iteration (post-MVP) to avoid increasing observability storage costs
Keep: Focus on small set of high-signal cards (volume, latency, errors) that drive operational actionability
Keep: Sampled tracing (1%) to balance signal vs cost; sampling rate configurable via console feature flag for enterprise customers
Tradeoff: Use daily batch aggregation for cost buckets (24h lag) instead of real-time cost streaming to reduce write amplification
